newsitem.title: USA: Citgo Tex refinery unit still off, restart unclear.
newsitem.headline: Citgo Tex refinery unit still off, restart unclear.

text.p: The alkalation unit at Citgo Petroleum's Corpus Christi, Texas refinery that was downed by a fire three weeks ago remains out of service and repairs on the unit have not yet begun, a company official said.
"It's still down and it's still under investigation. The repairs have not begun," said Citgo spokesman Kent Young.
Asked if the unit's return to service would be in weeks or months, Young suggested it could be either.
He noted all other units at the refinery, which has crude distillation capacity of about 130,000 barrels per day (bpd), were operating normally.
The downed alkylation unit, which produces high quality gasoline blending components, has production capacity of as much as 21,000 bpd.
Citgo is a subsidiary of PDV America Inc, itself a division of state-owned Petroleos de Venezuela SA.
-- Oliver Ludwig, New York Energy Desk, 1 212 859 1633
